description: Utility class for processing patterns, templates, and JSON data within the Thingsboard rule engine API.

classes.name: TbNodeUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for pattern processing, JSON data handling, and template formatting within the Thingsboard rule engine.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts configuration data to a specified class type using Jackson.

methods.name: processPatterns
methods.description: Processes a list of string patterns, replacing placeholders with data from a TbMsg.

methods.name: processPattern
methods.description: Processes a single pattern string, replacing data and metadata placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: processTemplate
methods.description: Replaces variables in a template string with corresponding data from a map.

methods.name: formatDataVarTemplate
methods.description: Formats a data variable placeholder for pattern replacement.

methods.name: formatMetadataVarTemplate
methods.description: Formats a metadata variable placeholder for pattern replacement.
